title: Wiki update: QuantStats tearsheet generator in tools/
rationale: Kevin shared quantstats (ranaroussi/quantstats) today. It's a direct productivity improvement for the backtest pipeline: one call generates polished HTML tearsheets with 50+ metrics and SPY benchmark comparison. Adding a wiki entry standardizes its use across all run_hNNN.py scripts. The tools/ section currently has no coverage of analytics/reporting libraries.
content: Already written at /workspace/agent/wiki/tools/quantstats-notes.md — this proposal tracks the wiki/index.md update needed to index it under the Trading wiki tools section.
